answer: Harbor sybil tax: each identity locks 70 credit and pays a per-epoch tax to the harbor, a beacon posting every bill on the public ledger. The tax starts at its nadir of 30 and climbs 9 per extra identity, so the k-th fake pays 30+9(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,525,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-tax ring fails since each bill binds one key to one berth. An honest agent pays 30 per epoch.
